basic_details.job_title: Nilachal Seva Pratisthan Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 8 Ayah, Cook and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Nilachal Seva Pratisthan is recruiting candidates for 8 vacancies across posts including Housemother, Housefather, Cook, PT Instructor Cum Yoga Trainer, House Keeper, Ayah (Female), and Chowkidar on a contract basis under the 2026 recruitment. Applicants must apply in the prescribed format by submitting a signed online generated printout along with required self-attested documents via speed post or registered post to the Secretary, Nilachal Seva Pratisthan, on or before 3 November 2026. Qualifications differ by post, and the engagement is purely temporary in nature, time bound and co-terminus

content_sections.heading: Nilachal Seva Pratisthan Housemother at a Glance

rows.details: Nilachal Seva Pratisthan, Child Care Institution (CCI) & Specialized Adoption Agency (SAA)
Housemother, Housefather, Cook, PT Instructor Cum Yoga Trainer, House Keeper, Ayah (Female), Chowkidar
Rs. 7,944/- to Rs. 14,564/- per month as per Mission Vatsalya norms

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates must apply in the prescribed online format available on the official website and submit the signed online generated printout along with required self-attested enclosures through speed post or registered post to: Secretary, Nilachal Seva Pratisthan, At-Dayavihar (Benagaon), Po-Gadasahi, Ps-Kanas, Dist-Puri, Odisha-752017 Candidates applying for different posts should send their applications along with enclosures in separate envelopes for each category of post.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Housemother: Graduate in Science/ B.Sc. Lower Age 21 years and upper age 45 years. Housefather: Graduate in Arts/BA - Preferably in Home Science, Sociology & Psychology. Lower Age 21 years and upper age 45 years. Cook: Under Matric (8th – 10th). Lower Age 21 years and upper age 45 years. PT Instructor Cum Yoga Trainer: MP.Ed / B.PEd / MA in Yoga / Bachelor Degree in Yoga / Diploma in Yoga or Equivalent Course. Lower Age 21 years and upper age 45 years. House Keeper: Under Matric (8th - 10th). Lower Age 21 years and upper age 45 years. Ayah (Female): Under Matric (8th - 10th). Lower Age 21 years and upper age 45 years. Chowkidar: Under Matric (8th - 10th). Lower Age 21 years and upper age 45 years.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopy of Secondary, HSC, Graduation, Post-Graduation or any other Professional qualification certificate and Mark sheet. One recent self-attested photograph (3.5 x 4.5 size) affixed to the application form. Certificate of experience issued from previous and current employer. Self-declaration regarding non-involvement in any criminal activities especially child-related offenses. (Police verification certificate shall be produced at the time of certificate verification). Training certificate (if any).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates shall be selected on the basis of protocol for engaging new staff for CCIs as per Resolution No. 10102-CW-MISC-0023-2020, dt. 15.09.2020 of the Department of Women & Child Development and Mission Shakti, Government of Odisha. The recruitment is based on career marking only as per the following weightage system: Secondary: 10 marks Higher Secondary: 15 marks Graduation: 25 marks Post-Graduation: 30 marks Any other professional course/Training related to child rights and its protection or MPhil, PhD etc.: 10 marks Work experience: 10 marks Total: 100 marks

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies available in Nilachal Seva Pratisthan Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available across various posts in the Child Care Institution (CCI) and Specialized Adoption Agency (SAA).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Nilachal Seva Pratisthan recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online generated printout along with self-attested enclosures via speed post or registered post is 3 November 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The lower age limit is 21 years and the upper age limit is 45 years as of the date of application.

faq.question: Q4. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the engagements are purely temporary in nature, time-bound, and co-terminus with the Revised Mission Vatsalya Scheme Provisions. Candidates engaged are not considered government staff.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection procedure?
faq.answer: Selection is based purely on career marking weightage across academic qualifications, professional courses, and work experience.

faq.question: Q6. How should I submit the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply in the prescribed online format through the official website www.nsp.org.in, and then submit the signed online generated printout through speed post or registered post to the Secretary, Nilachal Seva Pratisthan.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for the Housemother post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Housemother post must hold a Graduate degree in Science (B.Sc).

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for Nilachal Seva Pratisthan recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.
